comparison.objective: Force a straw through a lidded cup’s X-slot to depth; candidate separates a dry parts/media mixture with a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial insertion through compliant flaps with controlled force versus bimanual screen handling and agitation-driven granular flow.
comparison.success_condition: Straw through the slot and within 20 mm of the cup bottom, released and still versus ≥98% media recovered with all washers retained and no spill/damage.
comparison.reason: Shared use of a physical opening is generic; the candidate tests selective many-body flow rather than forceful single-part insertion.
